newsitem.title: USA: Republicans reject Democrat delay on Gingrich.
newsitem.headline: Republicans reject Democrat delay on Gingrich.

text.p: House of Representatives Republicans on Tuesday rejected a Democratic motion to delay a vote on re-electing House Speaker Newt Gingrich.

The vote against the Democratic motion was 222-210 with four Republicans joining 205 Democrats and one independent in calling for appointment of an interim speaker. The House then began a vote on Gingrich's re-election.
